package handler

import (
	bots "GENRE_MODULE/loadtest"
	"GENRE_MODULE/protocol/pb"
	"context"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/runner"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/robot/transport"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func completeScenarioRobot(t *testing.T, f *scenarioFixture, addr string) {
	t.Helper()
	run := func(token string, steps ...bots.Step) {
		t.Helper()
		r := bots.Commands(runner.Config{Count: 1, Duration: 5 * time.Second, Transport: transport.Config{Endpoint: addr}}, func(*robot.Context) (*transport.Packet, error) { return transport.AuthPacket(token), nil }, steps)
		if err := r.Run(context.Background()); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if s := r.Stats(); s.Success != 1 || s.Failure != 0 || s.Canceled != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("robot: %+v", s)
		}
	}

	// Smoke 已完成第一拍，后续双方交替直到胜负；重连重投仍是同一业务命令。
	for turn := 1; turn < 5; turn++ {
		actor := turn % 2
		token := "fixture-owner"
		if actor == 1 {
			token = "fixture-peer"
		}
		c := f.command(t, actor, "attack")
		request := pb.ScenarioCommandRequest{RoomID: f.room.ID(), Seq: c.Seq, Revision: c.Revision, Kind: c.Kind}
		run(token, bots.Step{Request: request, Revision: c.Revision + 1}, bots.Step{Request: request, Revision: c.Revision + 1, Reconnect: true})
	}
	s := f.state(t)
	if !s.Finished || s.Winner != 0 || s.Revision != 5 {
		t.Fatal("match did not finish with one winner")
	}
	c := f.command(t, 0, "attack")
	request := pb.ScenarioCommandRequest{RoomID: f.room.ID(), Seq: c.Seq, Revision: c.Revision, Kind: c.Kind}
	run("fixture-owner", bots.Step{Request: request, WantCode: 1})
	run("fixture-outsider", bots.Step{Request: request, WantCode: 1})
	if f.state(t).Revision != 5 {
		t.Fatal("terminal changed")
	}
}
